entries.8bb6addf4d120a94: This business sells LP gas and housing equipment. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥22,479 million, making it the main business, accounting for about 7 tenths of consolidated sales. In addition to the company, the consolidated subsidiaries Marushin Gas, Kohto Gas, Fumoto Shokai, Kakumaru Energy, Taiyo Propane and Kusanen sell in their respective areas, and Iwasaki Flowtech carries out equipment construction. The affiliates Ehime Benny and Five Star Gas also sell LP gas and equipment purchased from the company.
